messages.subject: R1054 pitch contract audit complete
messages.body: Audited the pinned SYCL matrix contract and exact QSA source path for the 36/260 BF16 SLM pitch candidate, including pointer alignment, producer/consumer extents, lifetime, padding, and admission payload. Both pitches satisfy the documented BMG stride rules with the current tile starts; the shared typed tile must grow to 9,216 BF16 elements, raising score-stride-33 payload to 30,272 bytes, while padding remains uninitialized under the logical load contract. Report records unmeasured hardware hypotheses, coherent 40/264 costs, source provenance, and a bounded Main-owned correctness/component/model plan; no implementation or tests were run.
